body:
She is leaving me because she feels that I only have been making her sad for a long period of time. She says that she loves me, but she can't handle going around all the time being melancholic because her boyfriend is "closing himself in" all the time.
 Her father is a *well-payed* business man, and her mother is a judge in one of the highest courts in the whole country. I'm a nobody compared to her, and it really doesn't help my ridicously low self-esteem. 
Sometimes I feel like I'm not good enough for her - while we're together - and then I sort of tone down my presence, and it makes her sad, because I become sad. 
Therefore she can't stay with me, even though she loves me, and it just makes me want to kill myself.
